mentions.name: Handle 汉兜
mentions.description: A Chinese Hanzi variant of Wordle called Handle 汉兜, packaged as a Discord activity/app (a webview/iframe launched inside Discord) so Discord groups can have fun solving Hanzi puzzles together, similar to NYT's official Wordle Discord app.
mentions.audience: Discord groups who want to play word puzzles together
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm trying to make a Chinese Hanzi variant of Wordle called Handle 汉兜 [0] available as a Discord activity/app so my Discord groups can have fun solving puzzles just like we've been having with NYT's official Wordle Discord app[1].
